question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (11)/(40) { (rounded off to two decimal places)?}
solution:
**Given:**

Value 1 = 1/20

Value 2 = 11/40

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value1 ÷ Value2) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ (1/20) ÷ (11/40)

⇒ = (1/20) × (40/11)

⇒ = 40/220

⇒ = 2/11

⇒ Percentage = (2/11) × 100

⇒ = 200/11

⇒ = 18.18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18%.**
